text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To have your life blessed by We. Know that 
this is the utmost felicity.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. I was so 
delighted by Orfevre-san's gift.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The foot reflexology machine... Yes, its 
power was tremendous. However, I've been 
feeling great ever since!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Why would anyone be happy getting 
something so cringey? Orfevre really has 
zero tact!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Since it's your birthday, I must bestow a 
special spell upon you! —Phalaenopsis 
Orchid☆ O Knight, receive my blessing!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My! A wizard's blessing...! Mmh, thank you 
very much. Lady Witch, I accept it with 
the utmost reverence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. To think you snapped at We for 
being "inconsiderate", only to show Us 
this... Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To think it would be mere words alone. 
What good is a gift without practical 
benefit?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah—!? Durandal! Magic would make you 
much happier, wouldn't it? I'll even cast 
a spell on you to vanquish evil!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You hold your ground? Very well. For a 
knight, receiving knighthood from the king 
is the supreme honor. Bring forth the 
sword. We shall show you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just an ordinary sword would be boring, 
right?! So how about I turn that sword 
into a magic sword for you!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Um, I am deeply grateful, but any 
knighthood must come from my Liege! 
Please, Lady Witch, calm down as well! At 
this rate, I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna turn into a knight... of sword 
and sorcery...!)
